title: Thangigagi
desc: Veerabhadra, who loves his sister very much, gets her married to a nice man. However, when Veerabhadra's close friend is killed, he decides to wipe out anti-social elements in the city.

title: Gaja
desc: A cat and mouse chase ensues between Gaja and a rival faction leader over a few startling events. Gaja tries to protect his friend, Krishna, and his lover, Shwetha, who are being targeted.

title: Kotigobba 3
desc: After succeeding at framing ACP Kishore, Satya goes on to become an international criminal. While he gets targeted by Interpol, Kishore seeks revenge on him too, upon being released from prison.

title: Banni Sambranisona
desc: Shiva, a carefree young man, falls for Bramaramba, who dreams of marrying a prince and their contrasting worlds and family expectations create challenges in their relationship.

title: Nanjundi Kalyana
desc: Raghuchandra changes his identity in order to marry his cousin to settle the family conflict between his father and aunt.
